photos.c: FRONTISPIECE (Photo by Ed.Lacey)--Gerry North splashes through a ford, between R. Grove and W. Adcocks in the National Championships.
In the National Championships at Leicester, Gerry North (11th) leads A. Rushmer (7th), A.Cox (9th) and R. Grove (10th) on the final lap.
This looks like a fair old field, and it is. Gerry North leads Bob Richardson, Jim Alder, Ron Hill, Tim Johnston, the great Gaston Roelants and Ron Grove in the Coca-Cola 30,000m.
